test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

They were __sure__ of their victory.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Doubtful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sure"** means having no doubt, being certain or confident about something. (निश्चित)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **sure **that she locked the door before leaving.
 
 
 
• **"Doubtful" **refers to being uncertain or lacking conviction about something. (संदिग्ध)
 
 
• **Example: **He was **doubtful **about the success of the new project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sure'** is **'doubtful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vengeful **(प्रतिशोधी): Seeking to harm someone in return for a perceived injury.

 
 
• **Example:** Her **vengeful **attitude made her plan to get back at her rivals.
 
 
 
• **Imprudent **(अविवेकी): Not showing care for the consequences of an action; rash.
 
 
• **Example: **It was **imprudent **of him to invest all his savings in one stock.
 
 
 
• **Confident** (आत्मविश्वासी): Feeling or showing certainty about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **confident **about her ability to finish the project on time.
